color: rgb(224, 242, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1. ENDOTHELIAL INJURY
Regurgitant jet, degenerative
or rheumatic valve, prosthetic
material, pacer lead, catheter

div.style: color: rgb(224, 242, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. NBTE
Sterile platelet-fibrin nidus
Non-bacterial thrombotic
endocarditis

div.style: color: rgb(224, 242, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. TRANSIENT BACTEREMIA
Dental / skin / gut / GU
Injection drug use, IV line

div.style: color: rgb(224, 242, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4. ADHERENCE
MSCRAMMs: FnBP-A/B,
clumping factor, Fim A
bind fibrin + fibronectin

div.style: color: rgb(224, 242, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5. AMPLIFICATION
Bacteria trigger more platelet
aggregation + fibrin deposition
burying themselves deeper

div.style: color: rgb(255, 228, 230) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6. MATURE VEGETATION
Avascular biofilm sanctuary
NO neutrophils - NO blood supply
10^9-10^11 CFU/g, mostly dormant

div.style: color: rgb(237, 233, 254) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LOCAL DESTRUCTION
Leaflet perforation, chordal rupture
Root abscess, fistula, pseudoaneurysm
AV block if it reaches the AV node

div.style: color: rgb(237, 233, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
EMBOLIZATION
Stroke, splenic/renal infarct
Mycotic aneurysm
Septic PE if right-sided

div.style: color: rgb(237, 233, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
IMMUNE COMPLEXES
Glomerulonephritis
Osler nodes, Roth spots
+RF, low complement

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PROPHYLAXIS
Amoxicillin 2 g PO
30-60 min pre-dental
only in highest-risk hearts

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
BACTERICIDAL IV ABX
High dose, 4-6 weeks
Must sterilize a site with no
immune access and slow growth

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SURGERY
Physically removes the sanctuary
when abx alone cannot win
